applies_why: It does the thing the rule governs by using the text's failure to name whose body is the channel as the reason for UNDERDETERMINED.
quote: the text names the seed of David 'according to the flesh' without naming whose body is the channel, so the point stays open.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: The phrase 'a single verse does not state a link'—I weighed whether it bars only explicit single-verse non-statement or bars treating any unstated detail as leaving the point open; under this text's reasoning it uses non-statement as its ground.
why: The judge leaves the point UNDERDETERMINED because the text does not name the channel, which is the forbidden non-statement ground.
